purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: White House Ballroom Lawfare 2025-2026
question: What are the separate construction, review, disclosure, congressional and judicial states in the White House ballroom dispute?
bluf: One live construction-authority case sits at the center of a wider pressure architecture: an aborted first suit, two FOIA cases, a donor-disclosure referral, post-demolition federal review and competing congressional bills. A D.C. Circuit majority affirmed preliminary relief, but Chief Justice Roberts stayed the injunction on August 21; construction may proceed while Supreme Court emergency review remains open and no final merits judgment exists.

retrieval_instructions: Open full_text_url for the package before treating a summary as the underlying research.
For a material with public_full_text true, prefer reading_url; failure to retrieve it is an access or crawler problem, not a private-by-design signal.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not infer contents.
Preserve the evidence cutoff. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
